decision: COARSE MESH REJECTED. Coarse vs medium fails C2, C4b, C5 and C6 (CRITERIA.md fixed 2026-11-05 17:55). Per the pre-registered decision rule, fine-mesh verification (V_MESH_fine_T_N40_SYM) is running; the main airflow queue stays gated until a fine-vs-medium decision is recorded here.
diagnosis: C5 delivery gap (-1.3 pts at 1/3/5 um) is explained by the extra coarse deposition: delivery among non-deposited particles agrees within 0.2 pts (coarse 36.43/36.53/36.63 % vs medium 36.27/36.40/36.62 %).

C6: coarse deposits ~4 pts more at every size (4.4 vs 0.5 % at 1 um), almost size-independent, spread over all regions, not at the inlet -> numerical deposition of air-following particles at under-resolved walls (no prism layers).

C4b: peak jet speed agrees (-2.3 %) but the post-narrowing jet in the coarse mesh bends 0.6-1.1 mm toward one wall at s = 30-35 mm while the medium jet stays near the axis; L2 is larger in the lumen core (54 %) than near the wall (28 %).

Timing pattern (diagnostic only): after removing each mesh's mean, 9/10 release bins agree within 2 SE at each size; bin-to-bin correlation 0.62-0.65; medium range 3.4 pts vs coarse 2.5 pts. Not sufficient to keep the coarse mesh.
consequence: All coarse-mesh v002 particle results (T_N40_SYM maps and 36 N40 baseline cases) are not valid for quantitative claims and are kept only as archived exploratory data. The production mesh will be medium or fine, decided by the fine-vs-medium comparison against the same criteria.
